findings.summary: Per-tile --accent scoping mixes hues within the expertise card row, violating the tile-row rule ('never mix hues within a row'). No hardcoded hex in JSX; the visual violation is via CSS variable override at the element scope. Accepted in the previous review cycle as a category-differentiation tradeoff.

Nav hover CSS uses .nav-link:not([style*='color: #60A5FA'])... which is likely to fail because browsers normalize hex to lowercase or rgb(). Active nav links would incorrectly respond to :hover with color: #111827. Replace with data-active attribute or nav-link--active className.

Expertise tiles, AI Lab tool cards, and operating principles grid use auto-fit minmax() inline styles instead of the spec-mandated grid lg:grid-cols-4 md:grid-cols-2 grid-cols-1 gap-4. Only the analytics KPI strip follows the specified pattern.
Homepage hero body paragraph uses maxWidth: '600px' instead of max-w-[65ch] as specified. 65ch ensures consistent line length at any font size scaling.
The kpis array in analytics/page.tsx retains a color field per entry that is no longer referenced in rendered JSX. Remove to avoid misleading future contributors into reintroducing per-card coloring.
